hooks.name: code-brain-session-start
hooks.description: Load Code Brain session context at the start of a Kiro session.

hooks.name: code-brain-user-prompt-submit
hooks.description: Load Code Brain prompt context before the model sees the submitted prompt.

hooks.name: code-brain-pre-tool-use
hooks.description: Check Code Brain command routing before a tool runs; a block decision denies the tool call (non-zero exit).

hooks.name: code-brain-post-tool-use
hooks.description: Record Code Brain tool-result context after a tool runs.

hooks.name: code-brain-stop
hooks.description: Advisory continuation feedback at end of turn (Kiro's Stop trigger cannot hard-block).
